purpose: N0-R2 source/license gate for identity-neutral public semantic bootstrap and evaluation candidates.
authority_boundary: A source listed here is not E0/E-INF/A-SYN authority. TRAIN_ALLOWED only means the reviewed license/source terms presently permit use in the N0 public training workflow subject to the recorded conditions. This is an engineering provenance decision, not legal advice.

sources.name: Common Pile v0.1 / Comma v0.1 training dataset
sources.license_expression: per-document/per-source open licenses or public domain; no single unified corpus license
conditions: Preserve source identity and applicable per-source/per-document license metadata in the A.L.I.C.E. training lineage ledger.
Do not relabel the consolidated dataset as MIT; the Common Pile maintainers explicitly rejected a unified MIT license for this corpus.
Filter or quarantine any document whose source/license metadata cannot be resolved to a license compatible with the intended use.
Retain an attribution/export ledger for sources whose licenses require it.
sources.notes: Preferred large-scale N0 foundation candidate because the project was intentionally built from public-domain/openly licensed text. The Common Pile authors also document possible license-laundering/metadata errors, so lineage and per-source license filtering remain mandatory.

sources.name: Common Pile v0.1 raw collection
sources.license_expression: per-corpus/per-document open licenses or public domain
conditions: Use only constituent corpora/documents whose exact license metadata is preserved and compatible with the intended training use.
Prefer the maintained/current source revision over stale training snapshots when licensing corrections were made.
Record source-level filtering and exact extraction code hashes.
sources.notes: The paper reports 30 public-domain/open-license sources and excludes NC/ND content under its open-license definition. Individual dataset cards warn that licensing metadata can still be imperfect.

sources.name: HuggingFaceFW FineWeb
sources.license_expression: ODC-By-1.0 dataset/database license; additionally subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use and underlying source terms
sources.attribution_or_sharealike: ODC-By attribution plus source-specific obligations may apply
conditions: Do not promote to TRAIN_ALLOWED merely because the dataset wrapper is ODC-By.
Underlying web-page rights/terms require a separate product/legal decision.
May be used for public research comparisons that do not enter permanent A.L.I.C.E. training weights.
sources.notes: Useful quality/data-pipeline comparator; not the default startup/commercial training foundation.

sources.name: PAWS / PAWS-Wiki
sources.license_expression: custom Google dataset license: may be freely used for any purpose; acknowledgement appreciated
conditions: Preserve source citation and exact archive revision in lineage.
Hold out final evaluation pairs before any curriculum/synthetic generation.
sources.notes: Strong candidate for SEM-02 and surface-robustness testing.

sources.name: Stanford Natural Language Inference Corpus (SNLI 1.0)
conditions: Record CC-BY-SA attribution and source-corpus lineage.
Before model release, obtain a project-level determination for how share-alike obligations apply to redistributed derived artifacts/weights.
Preserve the official train/dev/test boundary and contamination keys.
sources.notes: License permits commercial use, but share-alike obligations require explicit downstream compliance planning.

sources.name: Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MultiNLI)
sources.license_expression: mixed permissive/open licenses: majority OANC; fiction includes CC-BY-SA-3.0, CC-BY-3.0, and US public-domain works
conditions: Preserve genre/source-specific license metadata where available.
Track CC-BY-SA and CC-BY attribution obligations separately from public-domain material.
Do not substitute the MIT license of the baseline-code repository for the corpus licenses.
sources.notes: The corpus paper explicitly states it may be modified and redistributed for typical ML uses and describes the mixed source licenses.

sources.name: Adversarial Natural Language Inference (ANLI)
conditions: Do not include in permanent commercial/startup training data.
Do not use as a release gate if that use would fall outside the noncommercial license.
Keep as optional research-only comparison unless separately relicensed.
sources.notes: Explicit NC restriction blocks default commercial training use.

sources.name: GoEmotions
sources.license_expression: repository code is Apache-2.0; dataset text is derived from Reddit comments and requires separate content-rights/terms review
sources.attribution_or_sharealike: repository-level Apache notice does not by itself resolve source-comment rights
conditions: Do not infer that Apache-2.0 on the code repository automatically licenses Reddit comment content for permanent model training.
Resolve original content/Reddit terms and dataset-specific rights before promotion to TRAIN_ALLOWED.
sources.notes: Semantically useful for EMO-01, but startup/commercial training permission is not treated as established by the repository license alone.

sources.name: PUB: Pragmatics Understanding Benchmark
sources.license_expression: dataset artifact license not yet verified in N0-R2
conditions: Keep research-only until exact dataset repository and artifact license are verified.
If cleared, reserve a contamination-locked held-out portion because this suite directly measures N0 pragmatics.
sources.notes: High diagnostic value; no training authorization yet.

sources.name: ImpliedMeaningPreference
sources.license_expression: dataset artifact license not yet verified in N0-R2
conditions: Keep research-only until exact dataset artifact license is verified.
If later used for training, preserve its correct/incorrect reasoning structure rather than flattening to generic text.
sources.notes: Potentially valuable curriculum for pragmatic distinctions, but not yet license-cleared.

sources.name: PaCE pragmatic/literal grounding benchmark
sources.license_expression: dataset artifact license not yet verified in N0-R2
conditions: Keep research-only until exact released artifact/license is verified.
Preserve as a held-out literal-grounding diagnostic if cleared.
sources.notes: Important counterweight to over-inference: N0 must improve pragmatics without pragmatic hallucination.
